title: Matt Ryan says Falcons' development of Michael Penix starts with getting him healthy

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Matt Ryan says Falcons' development of Michael Penix starts with getting him healthy
sources.description: Two years after the Falcons made Michael Penix the eighth overall pick in the draft, the new regime in Atlanta has not made any commitments to Penix as the franchise quarterback going forward.
